usedFor: GMass runs email campaigns and Zoom hosts the webinars, so “Email Replied” can feed “Register Attendee for Webinar”.

bestTemplate.name: “Email Replied” in GMass, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: A reply shows interest, so that person is registered without anyone retyping their details.

watchOut: GMass triggers are polling, so “Email Replied” reaches Zoom after a scheduled check, not instantly.
